fray.name: Swell Wisp
fray.pattern: A gold glow on a label or a claim that has grown bigger than what holds it up. It shines brightest where the words say more than the evidence.
fray.weakness: Fit the claim to its support: qualify it, or find more support.

fray.name: Shadow Twins
fray.pattern: Two shadows that always move together, so one seems to cause the other.
fray.weakness: Look for a case where one is present and the other is not. A control or a counterexample separates them.

fray.name: Hasty Hydra
fray.pattern: Each head grew from one example. 'All' and 'always' are its favourite words.
fray.weakness: One good counterexample cuts a head. Wider sampling stops it growing back.

fray.name: Glimmer Knight
fray.pattern: It shines with a famous seal and stuns the crowd for a moment.
fray.weakness: Ask for the source. The shine fades when nothing is under the seal.

fray.name: Echo Moths
fray.pattern: A swarm that copies itself. The louder and more often a claim is repeated, the bigger the swarm.
fray.weakness: Find the first source and test it. Volume adds no support.

fray.name: Hornet of Blame
fray.pattern: It stings a person's reputation, not their claim.
fray.weakness: Ignore the sting. Answer the claim and its support.

fray.name: Symbol Mirage
fray.error: A symbol in place of an object
fray.pattern: A shimmer that looks like knowledge: glasses for 'perspective', a trophy for 'winning'. Nobody made, used or argued about it.
fray.weakness: Choose a real, specific object that shows knowledge at work in the world.

fray.name: Checklist Golem
fray.error: Naming concepts instead of using them
fray.pattern: A golem made of ticked boxes. Every concept name is on it, and none of them does any work.
fray.weakness: Say what this one object shows, in a sentence that could not fit any other object.

fray.name: So-What Sphinx
fray.pattern: It blocks the way and asks one question: so what?
fray.weakness: Say what follows: who acts differently, or what we now know or doubt.

fray.name: Confirmling
fray.pattern: It swallows any evidence that agrees with it and grows bigger.
fray.weakness: Run a fair test that could prove it wrong.

fray.name: Strawman
fray.pattern: A scarecrow golem that attacks a weak copy of your claim.
fray.weakness: Restate your real claim. The golem loses its target.

fray.name: Anchor Crab
fray.pattern: It holds on to the first number it sees.
fray.weakness: Take a fresh, independent measurement.

fray.name: Fog Wraith
fray.pattern: It changes the meaning of a word in the middle of a fight.
fray.weakness: Pin down a clear definition.

fray.name: Mimic Chest
fray.pattern: It looks like a treasure chest or an old object.
fray.weakness: Check its layers and its provenance.

fray.name: Bandwagon Beetles
fray.pattern: They get stronger as more beetles join.
fray.weakness: One independent witness breaks the line.

fray.name: Gambler's Imp
fray.pattern: It bets that a 'due' result will come.
fray.weakness: Show the real odds.

fray.name: Cherry-Picker Crow
fray.pattern: It steals the evidence that does not fit.
fray.weakness: Restore the full record and check the gaps.

fray.name: Survivor Shade
fray.pattern: It shows only the winners.
fray.weakness: Search for the missing cases.

fray.name: Twin-Gate Hound
fray.pattern: Two heads block a door with two choices.
fray.weakness: Find the third option.

fray.name: Slippery Slime
fray.pattern: It slides you toward a disaster, step by step.
fray.weakness: Ask for evidence for each step.

fray.name: Hush Moth
fray.pattern: A grey moth that eats plain words and leaves soft ones behind, so a hard thing becomes hard to say, and a shared problem has no name.
fray.weakness: Name the thing plainly. Ask what each word makes people notice, and who chose the word.
